programme.desc: 新店在羅茲卡爾德開張,但商店和學校出現了一些問題。與此同時,智樹為了得到巴和萊姆的刀, 試圖用能魅惑人心的魔眼力量。

programme.title: 月光下的異世界之旅 第二季 #7
programme.desc: 回到亞空後,真受到了驚喜派對的熱烈歡迎。晚宴過後,巴向真報告星湖和智樹的事,過程中真詢問亞空異常炎熱的原因,從巴那裡得知關於亞空的新事實。隔天,亞空舉行迎接新種族入住的“新成員選拔”。

programme.title: 月光下的異世界之旅 第二季 #8
programme.desc: 在繁忙而愉快的時光中,真和識回到羅茲卡爾德繼續努力工作。與此同時,在羅茲卡爾德中央學園,復學的希芙連布蘭多和優諾連布蘭多,還有轉學生卡蓮弗魯斯加入真的課程。

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #9
programme.desc: 杜克向艾莉西亞表達出強烈的情感,艾莉西亞卻下意識地抗拒他,她對自己的反射行為感到困惑,於是重新思索杜克在自己心裡的定位。接著艾莉西亞為了讓自己像個壞女人而付諸行動。

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #10
programme.desc: 威爾在羅亞納村將自己的過去娓娓道來――那是一段圍繞著年少悔恨與陰謀的過往。聽他話完當年的艾莉西亞回到學校後,校內卻又出現舉止可疑的學生,她會被新的陰謀所牽連嗎?

programme.title: 海賊王 #496
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 你是主角

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂

programme.title: 專題講座:張路加牧師宣教培靈系列

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室

programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天3 誰主生死
programme.desc: 死亡,是每一個人必經階段,但當與死亡直接交鋒的時候,大部份人仍然會手足無措。有見《如果還有明天2》的反應理想,創世電視籌備了特別版,訪問多位醫學界專業人士,分別有香港中文大學醫學教授沈祖堯、精神科醫生莊紹賢透過他們切身之痛的經歷,將見證結合醫學知識,剖析人面對死亡時如何提供深層的安慰,讓

programme.title: 葛培理牧師特輯
programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.desc: 「一代賊王」葉繼歡今晨於瑪麗醫院羈留病房因癌症病逝,終年55歲。 這個曾經手持AK47在街上亂槍掃射、令人聞風喪膽的賊王在被捕、越獄後再犯案。一次偷渡回港時,中槍被捕,成為半身癱瘓的囚犯。 葉繼歡於2004年歸信耶穌,2010年更親筆回信給《天使心》。 今天,小編在整理葉繼歡的書信時,發現了這一句話

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#82粵
programme.desc: 溢看到滿身血跡的義和拿刀的智貞，欲救人時卻滑倒地上。溢醒過來後竟「時光倒流」，他以為是上天給他拯救家人的機會。可惜幾番努力仍不得要領，反令貞認定溢來作弄她，貞怒極詛咒高家眾人要死！溢欲將家人強留在家。

programme.title: 尚食#22粵普
programme.desc: 子衿為躲避彭城伯夫人逃到書房，瞻基一邊為她掩護，一邊諷刺她機心重。皇上進食時突感不適，太子妃質疑八珍糕有問題，子衿冷靜地解釋。皇上欣賞子衿的聰慧，正要獎賞，皇后突然言明子衿的身分，提議冊封她為太子嬪。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 阿譚不吝嗇地拿出A5和牛，並分享正確的解凍步驟。阿爺卻選用水晶梨與甜豆，再以中式方法烹調和牛？和牛油脂多，炒煮時仍要加少許油，有何原因？鼎爺豪氣地用兩斤雞項，炮製更濃味的「豆豉雞煲」回敬阿譚。豆豉預先炸過不易溶化，而整個過程不加水，上枱前還有灒酒一步，滋味更濃！二人到唐餅店見識皮蛋酥的工序後，回到廚房自製「酥脆蛋散」。很多食物都是熱食才美味，蛋散卻不宜趁熱品嚐；而麵糰的搓揉及發酵時間亦要好好掌握。

programme.title: 渣打香港呈獻：財富之道粵
programme.desc: 《渣打香港呈獻：財富之道》，每集邀請各界精英與銀行專家，在輕鬆氛圍下暢談財富投資熱話，包括財富管理、AI投資、利率走勢、醫療保險及多元資產配置。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 醫學上縱無法根治柏金遜症，但可減慢病情惡化。神經科醫生細說此症成因與病徵，也會概述臨床診斷方法。早期柏金遜症患者，可按不同症狀服用對應藥物，晚期患者又可怎樣治療？兩位肝癌康復者到來受訪，提到接受肝臟移植手術後仿如「重生」，並加入相關義工團體，向同路人分享經驗。此外，團體每年舉辦名為「重生盃」的羽毛球比賽，推廣器官捐贈。「睇餸食飯」環節，傅季馨炮製一道「新鮮菠蘿炒飯」，菠蘿要新鮮，再加海鮮夠美味！

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 高血壓是常見健康問題之一，本港15歲或以上人士約兩成七患有高血壓，而75歲或以上患高血壓的比率超過七成三，情況值得關注。這次請來對高血壓十分關心的支嚳儀，本集亦有胡依諾醫生為大家解構高血壓問題，而註冊中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，也會在節目中跟大家分享高血壓的食療與降壓穴位。

programme.title: 五味人生#14粵PG
programme.desc: 若嵐被永禎嚇暈，醒後回復所有記憶；但無法想通雙春為何不離開，反而苦苦支撐酒樓及關家。飛揚要九妹煮出五碟同樣的菜式，指當中暗藏一個課題。九妹請眾人幫忙，雙春讓九妹明白自己的味覺出現問題，只得請雙春陪他求醫……雙春在發悶氣，永禎向她坦言說出九暗戀她。勝天把戲票連汽車及保鏢也借給永禎「會佳人」，永禎卻被誤認是勝天而遭綁架；飛揚竟決定不付贖金。雙春與九妹與綁匪見面，希望他們釋放永禎，九妹與對方大打出手……

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 為了幫助大家強化心肺功能，兒童體適能教練於「WORKOUT 2GETHER」教做碎步跑、抬腿，再繞着地下的飛碟跑圈，然後邊走邊跳。喘氣反應實屬正常，最後以伸展動作完成整套鍛練，舒展一下肌肉。第二輪的訓練則針對手眼協調及平衡力，拋高豆袋，專注留意豆袋的動向去接住，再加上拍手、二人拋接等元素，難度與趣味大增。嘗試將豆袋放於頭頂，眼望前方走動，也可考驗平衡力。另播放《河馬與小鳥》的AI生成動畫下半部。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 第五次偶像公主大賽突然拍板舉行。假若Quartet STAR勝出，就能救回阿紡，但假若由暗黑千依勝出，Quartet STAR就會跟阿紡一樣被囚禁。面對這個危險的對決，阿櫻四人仍然態度堅決，令陽葵很想知道她們強大的秘密。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 香港的豬場數目，由七十年代的四千多戶，不斷縮減，直至現在只餘下四十多個，本地養豬業，是否走向末路呢？新聞掏寶和大家重溫2005年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 滙豐Premier Elite 呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
滙豐保險呈獻 :準備退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 有市民發現，理應受管制的「減肥針」與「聰明藥」竟可在網上輕易買到，情況猖獗。攝製隊直擊交收過程，並嘗試追查藥物來源。藥劑師提醒，胡亂使用相關藥物或會損害健康。佘詩曼、馬貫東拍攝《正義女神 番外篇》，阿佘透露內容跟原劇有關連。不少人士受關節痛困擾，這集帶來有助舒緩的資訊。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2792粵
programme.desc: 吳旺達贊助拍攝短劇，期間生出事端，Bonnie為救城安甘代其受罰，幸此時遇到嫻姐，獲她出面調解。Bonnie將與蔥頭之母會面，本憂心她難相處，及後知悉對方是嫻姐，便感鬆一口氣。嫻姐卻提出要Bonnie與蔥頭分手，原來嫻姐認為她與城安糾纏不清。城安後來在片場遇到嫻姐，本欲避嫌，但事與願違。城安為讓嫻姐相信他已與Bonnie撇清關係，付出不少努力，並因某人之故，事情越鬧越大，Bonnie卻發現不妥……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#19粵PG
programme.desc: 惠知向光正隱瞞病情，堅持完成審理「焦屍案」才接受手術。淑樺代表景翔，自信他可無罪獲釋。惟審訊期間，另一被告關勝輝轉為污點證人，供出景翔是團夥的首領……真相逐步揭出，惠知卻因病不支昏倒在庭上，案件轉由邵文接手審理。淑樺突然提出景翔的不在場證明，揭示他雖然就案發當日的行蹤說謊，但背後另有苦衷。最終，邵文以專業態度處理眼前證據，持平地審理案件……沒人想到，景翔有恃無恐，竟與網友一同策劃更瘋狂的遊戲。

programme.title: 大生意人#14粵普PG
programme.desc: 九帥要帶走李成的屍體，依梅情急之下昏倒，平原把依梅帶回家，但她一直昏迷不醒。胡老太爺著急地找平原幫忙，原來之前平原惹惱了萬堂，萬堂和外國茶商約定，一兩安徽茶都不許買，令安徽茶出口海外的銷路全部斷掉。

programme.title: 試真D粵PG
programme.desc: 另類配搭的壽司逐一試，蔓越莓開心果牛肉獲美儀姐、朱仔好評；山楂扣肉、芋泥口味奇怪，GM還初嚐豬腦，反應令人意外！三水臭屁醋臭出名堂，以此湯底打邊爐，只有零次或無限次？朱仔出動鼻塞、口罩進店，卻吃不停……衣服殘留氣味好難頂，用餐後要緊急處理。評分僅27的酒吧，竟主動要顧客畀負評，顛覆點評玩法。玩味十足的雞尾酒獲三主持認同，有人更呃酒飲？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#12粵
programme.desc: 雜誌社記者採訪談判小組，國棟一再叮囑組員要慎言，免將談判機密洩露。記者Joe對楊光首次勸服事主的個案感興趣，遂追問詳情。訪問完畢，卻意外發現組員忠耀遺下的機密文件。國棟責楊光洩漏資料，楊光感屈辱，一怒辭去談判工作。可人往報館找Joe對質，Joe承認是根據拾獲的機密文件描述事件，絕非楊光外洩資料。國棟知錯怪楊光並誠意挽留楊光，但楊光不為所動。可人漸對楊光產生好感，到處搜尋楊光喜歡的襟章送贈。

programme.desc: 世上最臭的食物有多恐怖？農夫以行動告知！台灣有何獨特形式吃臭豆腐？同時設自助洗衣區及咖啡店的三藩市小店，為何晚上才吸引顧客？馬國明、陳煒絞盡腦汁回答一系列問題，還一同欣賞曼谷大師的「Do姐肖像果雕」。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵

阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺親到本地蔗田揀靚竹蔗，再教大家煲「竹蔗茅根馬蹄飲」。香口蔗蝦令食指大動，鼎爺還特意將蔗切成扁平狀，以加入肥豬肉的蝦膠包住。想成品鬆化，在調製粉漿時需下點功夫。鼎爺再以原條黃鱔炮製「黃鱔焗飯」，飯熟後放上洗好的黃鱔焗熟，然後灒油及淋上煲仔飯豉油；醃黃鱔時加入生粉有何作用？將黃鱔起肉切絲，則可製作「銀芽肉絲炒鱔糊」，先將鱔絲醃香走油。烹調時如何減少銀芽出水？菜式上碟後，鼎爺在蒜上灒豬油，提升香味！

programme.title: 滙豐保險呈獻 :準備退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 皮膚如受紫外線刺激，容易出現色斑、皮膚暗沉。學者細述色斑中的雀斑、曬斑、荷爾蒙斑特徵，並提供舒緩建議。他還分享挑選防曬產品貼士，解釋「SPF」與「PA」的含義。家庭心理治療師指出，離婚人士多會出現指責、憂鬱等心理階段。若未能妥善疏導，容易令雙方產生更多爭拗。父母離異亦可能影響子女，甚至帶來負面情緒。親友如想支援離婚者，嘉賓建議從陪伴與聆聽着手。「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅巧炸一道「懷舊上海春卷」。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 新冠肺炎是近年大疫情，持續數年，備受市民關注。《醫度講》這集請來朱智賢細述患上新冠肺炎的經過，並有陳佔耀醫生為大家解構新冠肺炎與「長新冠」問題。註冊中醫師何慧欣、營養師李澄琳也會在節目中跟大家分享治療及預防新冠肺炎的食療。

programme.title: 五味人生#15粵PG
programme.desc: 永禎與雙春逃走時不慎墮崖，雙春為救永禎身陷險境；永禎竟趁機向她表白……飛揚正欲讚賞九妹能練成將菜式的味道統一，九妹卻坦白說出自己的病情。鎮長與所長及鄉親到臨關家，提出將為雙春設立貞節牌坊；關老太眾人贊成，雙春沒法提反對……永禎通知雙春決定帶她離開佼佼鎮；但當冷靜下來，卻擔心雙春跟隨自己會變成騙子夫婦，要求九妹帶雙春離開。若嵐威迫利是妹供出雙春與人約會地點；更以大少奶身分要眾人助她捉姦……

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 猴子活潑好動，女繪畫導師在「Artspiration」教授怎樣刻劃猴子的特徵，令作品更傳神。她還指導玲玲姐姐畫出攀樹的猴子，趣味十足。「開心SHARE」環節開始時，玲玲姐姐率先帶來乘坐的士的出糗經歷，還自嘲是「蠢豬」。小朋友也投稿描述不同校園趣事，並勾起主持們的有趣回憶。玲玲姐姐某次在海傍散步時不慎撞上燈柱，留下痛楚記憶；彤彤姐姐則因錯認陌生人是其朋友而揮手，場面尷尬搞笑。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 黑暗Quartet STAR以霸者姿態突然現身，假如沒人能夠戰勝她們，她們就會將偶像公主空間據為己有。學生會四人沒法進入偶像公主空間，阿紡仍然被囚，令陽葵愈感焦急，更開始為自己的無力而沮喪……

東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2793粵
programme.desc: 熊家因故遭賊人洗劫一空，理應重新購置生活所需的設備，樹根卻堅決不肯。城安等人苦不堪言，遂分工購置家具及電器，試圖讓生活重回正軌，卻唯獨漏了「它」。「它」的功能已可被其他產品取替，眾人遂覺得「它」變得「可有可無」，但樹根缺少了「它」，卻感不習慣。尚善遂滿足樹根的需求，城安更提議將「它」升級。升級後的「它」有不少好處，但樹根仍感不滿，眾人本以為樹根只是不習慣，最終卻發現背後另有隱情……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#20粵PG
programme.desc: 惠知接受手術後暫住光正家，同時忙於審理「銷贓案」，竟發現贓物中有屬於Lydia的手鐲！偉迪逮捕小偷，繼而在山上尋獲Lydia的枯骨！另一邊廂，景翔與網友密謀，以「太空油」迷暈少女凌虐……惠知藉銷贓案，試圖找出成彬殺人的證據，希望光正幫忙取得相關片段；惟片段硬碟到手不久，已被人偷走。惠知懷疑背後是淑樺指使，在庭上傳召律政司人員，以調查證據失竊一事。惠知卻被淑樺乘機聲討濫用職權，法官之位岌岌可危！

programme.title: 大生意人#15粵普
programme.desc: 平原找仲登合作賣安徽茶到印度，吳財神把全省的茶運到十六鋪碼頭，萬堂認為平原做法是跟大清朝國法對抗，但赫德找不出問題，海關的船截停軍艦，仲登說服船長等待糾紛處理結果，萬堂和平原在劉瑞芬調解下仍僵持不下…

programme.title: 試真D粵
programme.desc: 許多港人近年「北上」玩樂，不論食、買、玩、住，想必已有一定心得，大家也希望尋找最高「性價比」的吃喝玩樂地點，獲得滿滿的「情緒價值」。主持江美儀暢遊深圳、珠海、惠州、東莞、潮州、汕頭等廣東省不同地方，每站聯同周嘉洛、朱敏瀚、曾展望、吳業坤當中兩位男拍檔，以顧客的身分測試多款美食可會有「伏」，探索各式玩樂景點值得光顧與否，為香港觀眾提供貼地的參考指數。

programme.desc: 顧客何美嬌常到福記光顧而認識國富，美嬌須已婚，但仍引誘國富。可人藉與家全往海馬公園為借口，邀楊光同行。談判小組聚會中，國棟游說楊光復職遭拒。國棟隨即要求與楊光擲飛鏢勝負定去留，結果，楊光負，守諾留任談判小組。國棟見國寶畢業後無所事事，計劃送她往外國升學，國寶卻不願。國富與美嬌搭上，美嬌夫周志成得悉後，持刀大鬧福記斬傷國富，更脅持國寶。楊光到場與志成談判，國棟責楊光於過程中違反談判手則，楊光不認同。

programme.desc: 手造皮鞋製作步驟繁複，黃耀英、黃建東請纓協助師傅造鞋，二人可會是「生蟲拐杖」？貨船上的「律囉」用作吊起貨物，亦撐起了四代木製品店的生計。律囉零件講求處處精準，製造過程更是「有規有矩」！歇後語「東莞臘腸－ 短肚闊封」，道出了廣東人機智靈巧的特質，這款特色臘腸還促成一段美滿良緣！粵劇團當然希望演出大收旺場，「爆棚」一詞原來叫人又喜又悲？另外，中文講師廖舜禧變身「生物教授」，揭開「好眉好貌生沙蝨」之謎。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 採用印度上乘檀香木製成的優質檀香扇，造工精緻且散發陣陣幽香。幸美被指「檀香木冚茅廁」，究竟怎麼一回事？郭師傅藉着拿手的雕刻工藝，為木製家品添上藝術美感；他在木板上刻字，當然不像主持般「木偶談戀愛－ 呆頭呆腦」！掌故專家鄭寶鴻提到昔日戲院觀眾喜歡「咬蔗」，還大談「揀蔗」心得，意欲何為？經過影視作品的傳講，金葉菊、梁天來成了悲慘人生的代名詞；大學講師廖舜禧亦會講解「豬頭丙」、「諸事喱」等趣怪人名起源。

隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 泰國清邁有一種世代以手相傳200多年的手工藝品-泰國紙傘 製作紙傘工序繁複, 取於自然的原材料, 靠著工匠的精湛手藝, 華麗變身成為色彩絢麗的泰國紙傘, 更是象徵清邁的手工藝品

programme.title: 翻生工程粵英
programme.desc: 工程師Rob Bell帶大家探討將廢棄結構轉變為未來建築背後的重大挑戰。

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 沙巴有一集住宅、購物中心、酒店等建設的大型項目，眾人參觀示範單位，巧遇在當地發展飲食生意的香港人，順道向她了解投資商機。品嚐地道炒粉麵美食期間，馬貫東提到退休後希望移居海邊，享受寧靜生活。三位美女聞言即租下一輛特色露營車，帶他到沙灘「Hea吓傾吓偈」。海風輕輕吹起，貫東打開心扉，還對着鏡頭向家人吐心聲。美女們又重提為貫東炮製的驚喜生日會，貫東如何被整？行程尾聲，三位閨密乘船出海，互訴旅途深刻點滴。

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵
programme.desc: 最後一集，淑雅、衍峰請來「美人魚」何泳芍一同出海，探索西貢地質公園的世界級奇岩怪石。遊遍橋咀洲、吊鐘洲、果洲群島，觀賞獨特風化岩洞。衍峰、泳芍急不及待潛水，細看海底生態！祖儀隨衍峰、淑雅遠離煩囂，往南丫島行山，順道體驗漁村文化。眾人由榕樹灣走到索罟灣，再登上漁排參觀漁民文化村，了解漁民的生活樂趣，然後回岸品嚐正宗海鮮大餐。穎彤夥拍嘉賓菊梓喬，與衍峰上演室內War Game大決鬥，最終鹿死誰手？

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 外國喜劇演員占基利以誇張的面部表情、豐富的肢體語言，帶給觀眾無限歡樂。谷主汛文整理了占基利的經典搞笑表情包，還與拍檔凱婷、泳嘉模仿其中三個，相似度如何？這位「喜劇之王」曾自揭患有抑鬱症，汛文提到這某程度反映「悲傷小丑悖論」，並指不少經典笑匠背後同樣藏有不為人知的悲傷。汛文亦概述占基利的成長故事，其幽默的起點，或許源於兒時希望逗抑鬱症母親開心。三位谷主還分享各自最欣賞的占基利電影，竟都不是喜劇作品？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 一路前行粵普
programme.desc: 一部聚焦中國生態保護，綠色高品質發展的環保公益紀實節目。透過沉浸式觀察新時代環保議題，並邀請胡歌、劉濤、陳龍三位明星親身參與，共同完成一場綠色低碳生活的行動。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: Gigi姐示範鹹豆漿。她這次用了新穎的組合去烹調，如櫻花蝦、飯素和紫菜，還有其他常見的配料，如榨菜、米醋和油條。她提到烹煮豆漿時不需要煮至沸騰，把所有材料放進碗裡後，把剛沸騰的豆漿倒進去便可以享用。

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 永城這集引領小朋友翻開「美醜」課題，先要大家說出最喜歡與眼中最美的藝人，永城是某孩子的選擇？長得美麗可會有好處？眾人各有想法。節目組還讓小朋友嘗試從兩個同品種的水果中選擇較好味一個，他們從中領略到外觀美麗的水果不一定較滋味。三位孩子互相拍照，永城看過作品，決定親自指導影靚相的技巧。永城要求兩位女生於園藝店內，各自選出認為最美與最醜的植物，她們有甚麼準則？大家又嘗試競猜植物的價錢，又可會跟外表掛鉤？

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵PG
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 太晴在鐵路同好的介紹下認識Delta，對方亦有在元宇宙建設鐵路，加上年紀相同，兩人一見如故。太晴約了一眾朋友去逛夏日祭，伊奈也獲准外出參與，玩得興高采烈之際，卻突然傳來敵人出現的警報。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 繼續有兒童體適能教練主理「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，拉伸手臂後就完成熱身。首先是爆發力訓練，一直向前走，沿路要蹲下或以弓箭步形式來觸碰地上的飛碟，加入聽指令運送豆袋、分隊鬥快元素，更能引導大家將潛能釋放。休息過後，就拿起橡筋帶，完成開胸及拉向後背的動作。跪在瑜伽墊，再做一輪掌上壓；轉二人一組，用橡筋帶製造「波浪」。最後教練還任由大家發揮創意，試試不用腳的情況下前後移動，集中鍛練上肢部位。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子在姐姐的同學面前，把姐姐的帽子沾上了鳥糞的事說了出來，令姐姐很不滿。小丸子因為怕辣，而被爸爸與姐姐嘲笑。之後小丸子見到幾位同學都不怕吃紅薑，令小丸子萌生了改變自己的念頭。

programme.title: 野性四季：珍稀野生動物在中國粵
programme.desc: 《野性四季：珍稀野生動物在中國》聯合世界頂尖野生動物拍攝團隊，透過以年為週期的野外追蹤拍攝，為動物國寶留存具有歷史意義和科學價值的珍貴影像檔案。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 巿面上有不少證書課程，聲稱獲美國、英國、南韓等國際權威資格認證，吸引不同業界報讀，部分課程收費數萬至十萬元。這些機構是如何認證課程呢？他們本身又有無合適資格去做專業認證？香港不少培訓機構提供這些證書課程，學員取得資格後可以擔任導師收生及提供服務，對消費者造成甚麼影響呢？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 滙豐保險呈獻：退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 平日愛下廚減壓的黃博為藍男夫婦準備泰、川美食，同時透露以環遊世界唱歌為退休願景。醫生鐘健禮則希望可享受無拘無束的退休旅行，並計劃循序漸進退休，還分享保持健康體魄的要訣。這集帶觀眾參觀泰國華欣國際級高球場附近的豪宅，環境優美，屋內更設透明電梯；主持亦體驗當野生動物義工，退休後仍何貢獻社會。主持們在深圳學駕帆船出海，感受「Chill」舒適樂趣；又到訪珠海的康養酒店，享受不同養生療程，展現多元退休生活。

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻:唱錢粵
programme.desc: 音準、拍子大考驗，唱歌隨時有錢落袋！《聲夢傳奇》唱將Windy詹天文接受《唱錢》洗禮，透過挑戰Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「過三關」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡，向打爆九宮格的目標進發。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 《J Music》致力打造高質音樂平台，一眾歌手有展示音樂實力的機會之餘，也可讓樂迷更深入了解歌手的音樂故事。節目邀請「人氣」歌手擔任嘉賓，由嘉賓親自挑選其喜歡的新舊作品，並即場演唱，分享喜愛曲目。而一些樂壇新面孔亦會亮相，透過互動交流，展現音樂潛力。此外，每集緊貼「勁歌金榜」最新形勢，送上歌曲MV外，還會帶來不同歌手、創作人或製作人的訪問，跟觀眾暢談作品，以至音樂業界的人和事。

programme.title: 風味人間 第2季粵
programme.desc: 汕頭除了滷水鵝聞名，經滷製的鵝肝口感肥美細膩；遠在法國，當地廚師亦是烹調鵝肝的大行家。意大利摩德納有一種名為豬蹄鑲肉的美食，將豬蹄拆骨釀入肉餡，再以低溫烘烤而成。鮟鱇魚這種深海魚，魚肝甘香，蒸煮後成為和風料理中的高級菜餚。在廣州，街頭飄送着牛雜、滷豬腳等的香氣，成為市井小食代表。浙江某個以手工釀造黃酒聞名的小鎮，在地民眾會利用釀酒後剩下的糟為豬蹄發酵增香；上海的糟豬蹄則以糟滷浸泡製作，風味各異。

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 場地單車世界盃香港站結束，這集搜羅比賽精華，一探海外選手來港參賽感受，以及裁判、支援團隊情況；三位年青港將也分享得着。NBL總決賽，香港金牛以總場數3比0擊敗對手，成就三連霸。拜仁慕尼黑與阿士東維拉將在啟德上演表演賽，名宿艾芬保、麥恩拿利來港宣傳。十八鄉鄉事委員會公益社中學三位中、長跑小將，在元朗區學界賽錄佳績，訓練上付出多少？冰球方面，帶來港隊出戰男子IIIB級別世錦賽戰報、大型五人賽記招花絮。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
寒戰粵PG
programme.desc: 警隊衝鋒車午夜被劫持，車內五位警員包括行動副處長李文彬獨子。下任處長兩大熱門人選：鷹派人物李文彬與年輕的劉傑輝都開始大施拳腳。文彬立即指揮營救，但賊人對警隊內部一切瞭如指掌，眾同袍懷疑他的決策，推舉傑輝接手整個行動。交收贖金過程中，傑輝設法令贖金留下線索，以便追查賊人位置。可是道高一尺，魔高一丈，傑輝非但找不著賊人蹤跡，還失卻巨額贖金，香港警隊陷入前所未有的危急與威脅……

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 「美醜」定義各有不同，有人注重外表，為了展現最美一面，會將照片修飾到滿意後才於社交媒體發放；有人則認為相由心生，內涵更重要。節目組請來四位藝人作自我介紹，並進行二選一問答與才藝表演，小朋友對各人的審美觀感可有變化？劉展霆、李爾晨均選擇以事業為先，為何被扣印象分？黃洛妍的小提琴造詣，打動小朋友心坎；獲讚顏值高的陳星妤，表演魔術卻似有失分……經過這次體驗，孩子們都認同才華內涵可令人發光發亮，變得更美！

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
搗蛋拉茶鋪
programme.desc: 熱愛拉茶的老闆，和自信滿滿的服務生狗狗，在飄著香氣的拉茶鋪裡享受著愜意的時光。然而一切平靜，都被一隻搗蛋的猴子破壞了！為了趕走猴子，狗狗與猴子的戰鬥即將展開！

programme.title: 搗蛋拉茶鋪
programme.desc: 熱愛拉茶的老闆，和自信滿滿的服務生狗狗，在飄著香氣的拉茶鋪裡享受著愜意的時光。然而一切平靜，都被一隻搗蛋的猴子破壞了！為了趕走猴子，狗狗與猴子的戰鬥即將展開！

programme.title: 夢怪護衛隊
programme.desc: 納喬和家人在一個夜晚搬進新城鎮，面對新家、新學校，一切都充滿未知的恐懼，而他的房間也藏著祕密：一群神秘又難以捉摸的怪物。但當噩夢來臨時，他們會成為最可靠的夥伴。

programme.title: 夢怪護衛隊
programme.desc: 納喬和家人在一個夜晚搬進新城鎮，面對新家、新學校，一切都充滿未知的恐懼，而他的房間也藏著祕密：一群神秘又難以捉摸的怪物。但當噩夢來臨時，他們會成為最可靠的夥伴。

programme.title: 森林偵探
programme.desc: 韓國教育電視台EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神秘事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧(完)
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林(完)
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 請叫我總監
programme.desc: 【《錦心似玉》譚松韻、《楚喬傳》林更新，秘書與總裁的職場愛情喜劇！】寧檬的夢想是成為一位投資總監，畢業後實際工作卻與夢想越來越遠。上司陸既明是一位業務能力強大的投資總裁，也不認為寧檬會成功。下定決心離開的寧檬因緣際會進入鷹石投資重新開始。一直看著寧檬的陸既明，在每次重要關頭還是會拉他一把，幫助她度過難關，兩人的相處，隨著一次次的突發事件心靠得越來越近。

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了
programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝朴星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市占率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會朴仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

programme.desc: 聰明倉鼠吉克、勇敢松鼠露比、大力狗狗阿力，還有疾速貓咪閃電，組成了宇宙最酷的超級英雄組合！他們幫助其他星球的居民解決問題，保護銀河系，並對抗邪惡又神秘的鐵鷹怪！

programme.title: 小小動物歷險記
programme.desc: 動物園可真是個瘋狂的地方！原本不在同一片大陸的動物，如今都在一起共同生活。但對一群好朋友來說，動物園就是他們的家！這裡有活潑好動的大象拉拉、聰明的鱷魚沃比、害羞的白虎咪噗、俏皮的水獺可可子，還有勇敢的鴿子狄爾，快來和我們一起認識這群朋友吧！

programme.title: 小小動物歷險記
programme.desc: 動物園可真是個瘋狂的地方！原本不在同一片大陸的動物，如今都在一起共同生活。但對一群好朋友來說，動物園就是他們的家！這裡有活潑好動的大象拉拉、聰明的鱷魚沃比、害羞的白虎咪噗、俏皮的水獺可可子，還有勇敢的鴿子狄爾，快來和我們一起認識這群朋友吧！

programme.title: 粉紅色口紅
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠經典復仇之作好閨密為渣男反目成仇】因做錯抉擇導致人生本末倒置的女人，經過4次婚姻終於找到真愛與幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初戀情人當成全部，放棄了自己的夢想，卻得到徹頭徹尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫朴正宇，圖謀佳恩家的財富和地位與佳恩結婚，在達到目的後將佳恩拋棄，轉而和情人美蘭結婚，陰謀奪得了佳恩父親的公司，並間接害死了佳恩的父親。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步從一位百合般純潔的女人，變成了帶刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【離家追夢，還是回家團圓？馮家菜北漂生存戰】馮家菜是北京頗具名氣的淮揚菜館，女強人大米憑藉一身拼勁，將小館打造成金字招牌，卻因妹夫欠債，陷入食品安全風波，生意一落千丈。為救餐館，她請出退休父親參賽，奪得全國冠軍，卻招來資本大鱷周路的覬覦。親情與利益交織，事業與愛情碰撞，兄妹間信任破裂，馮家菜面臨生死存亡。當大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子終於悔悟，全家攜手重建家業。當揚州炒飯再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改變。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金馬演員攜手演出破產母女生存記】少見的審計職場劇，樂觀正向，帶給人心激勵。從小在拮据家庭成長的邱冬娜，在課業工作上總是特別勤奮，希望透過自己的努力讓母親過上好生活。畢業後，因緣際會下進入了前輩顧飛開的審計稽核公司，面對孤僻但能力強的主管顧飛，邱冬娜雖然頭痛但絕不認輸！運用從母親身上學到的智慧，還有艱困生活帶給她的精打細算體質，邱冬娜總能屢出奇招化解艱難任務。曾有心理創傷的主管顧飛，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，兩人亦師亦友,相互扶持鼓勵，逐漸治癒傷口，成為彼此的靈魂伴侶。

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 另一種藍(完)
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 南風知我意
programme.desc: 【《蓮花樓》成毅在搭張予曦，再現《與君歌》絕美默契！！】藥物研發員傅雲深與外科醫生朱舊至偏鄉進行人道醫療救援，兩人從誤解到經歷生死危機而兩情相悅，彼此還不及坦承心意就遭逢巨變，從此斷絕聯繫。一年後的重逢，面對傅雲深的刁難與變化，朱舊堅韌及樂觀並不離不棄的守候，陪他度過每個春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 六龍飛天
programme.desc: 李成桂為了正式的投身政治啓程去往開京，李芳遠也跟隨着父親去了開京。來到開京的李芳遠看到了置百姓死活於不顧只為自己填飽肚子的權文勢族，無法抑制住自己內心的憤怒。原本就對於李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁謙將李成桂邀請到自己家裏並舉辦了宴會，在宴會上李仁謙給他看了以他背叛了曾經像兄弟一樣的趙小生為題材的街頭劇。在宴會結束後李成桂為了讓李仁謙保守自己背叛趙末生的秘密，向李仁謙低下了頭，李芳遠目擊到了這一幕。

programme.title: 大學成人式-被不良少年迷住3-
programme.desc: 【《魷魚遊戲》李廷晙、DAY6元弼、CIX炫晳、EPEX琴洞弦，眾多偶像齊聚一堂，共譜青春愛情劇！！】因一場誤會讓模範生妍鬥與校園惡霸賢浩有了連結，在結束了高中時期的紛擾，進入大學就讀的妍鬥與賢浩，以為平靜的日子將會是日常生活。隨著新認識的朋友，兩人想解決複雜的誤會和矛盾產生，看似複雜的愛情公式，誰才是妍鬥最終的選擇?

programme.title: 玉面桃花總相逢
programme.desc: 本劇改編自藍艾草的同名小說，許清嘉自幼父母雙亡，寒門苦讀成榜眼，與世交胡家的小女胡嬌喜結連理。胡嬌雖然出身屠戶家，不通文墨，但性格開朗積極、不拘小節，將一切打理得井井有條。

programme.title: 人氣封鎖中:UserNotFound
programme.desc: 遇到同音同名也同時作為轉學生的機率，是旼財意想不到的巧合。與作為人氣女王敏在協議交換身份生活，原本逐漸透明的生活開始畫上色彩。隨著時間害怕被拆穿，同時只在敏在面前直率的申義俊，在他的陪伴與守護找到自我。

Together, they will learn about gratitude, the importance of giving "thanks" and appreciating what we have to always see the positive side of life. Curious will teach us about gifts such as love and friendship which are invisible but very valuable and we should be grateful to have them.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Cheesy Bang Bang
programme.desc: The cheese delivery race is on as Mojo and the racer top try to deliver food faster than Filo. But the competition gets too hot when an explosive souffle is on the table!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Bedroom
programme.desc: Chilli and Bandit transform the old nursery into a new bedroom for Bluey. In the process, Bluey and Bingo amicably divide their belongings, but get absorbed by trading items and swapping notes at bedtime. Ultimately, when Bluey misses her sister, she asks to return to her old room.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Cricket
programme.desc: During a friendly game of neighbourhood cricket, the dads struggle to bowl Rusty out.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Love Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee gets a card from someone he loves, the Squirrels ask: does he still love them? In a show-stopping song, Delivery Chipmunk shows them the answer is a resounding YES.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Shopping Badge
programme.desc: Duggee loves to shop local, so the Big Shop is a Big Deal for him. He's over-excited and wants two of everything. The Squirrels have to remind him 'we only popped in for milk!'

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Song of Peace
programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Climate Change, The Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are watching for polar bears, but an iceberg is heading for their ship!

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Chickenrat
programme.desc: It's bedtime and Bingo can't remember where she left her beloved Floppy. Retracing their steps, Bingo and Bluey lead their Mum through their bizarre day in the hope of tracking her down.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Baby Race
programme.desc: Mum reminisces about Bluey and Judo as babies. Bluey learnt to roll over first, but Judo was the first to crawl, so then it became a race to see who was going to walk first.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Pass the Parcel
programme.desc: Lucky's Dad is outraged that modern Pass the Parcel has a present in every layer and changes the rules back to only having one prize in the middle, but Bingo is forever losing.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Perfect
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. While recalling her favourite memories of playing with Bandit, Bluey struggles with the idea that her drawing must be perfect. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.desc: Roly needs a wee, but the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Frog Song
programme.desc: It's fun on the counting train until Naughty Monkey starts to drive! Ethel makes a shape, Frog drops beats with a ribbit song, and Enid turns into anime to chase after a mouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - What's Hot?
programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken A&amp;E, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about what's hot and what's not.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - I'm Hungry
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Whale Watching
programme.desc: Bluey promises her customer, Bingo, the best tour ever in a game of Whale Watching, but they need Mum and Dad to join in, and they are too tired to play after a late night.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Family Meeting
programme.desc: When Dad's accused of fluffing in Bluey's face as he climbed out of bed, he's put on trial with Mum as the judge, and Bluey and Bingo as witnesses. Bluey might also have to explain what she was doing there.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Faceytalk
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with Muffin and Socks so they can all draw pictures together. When Muffin won't give Socks a turn, the kids discover what happens when you hog.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Day Trip
programme.desc: The Teletubbies go on a day trip to the Hidey Hup. They take turns on The Tubby Bouncy, The Tubby Slidey and The Tubby Spinny before they go on The Tubby Uppy Downy together.

programme.title: Teletubbies Ready Steady Go! (S1) - Silly Things
programme.desc: Join the dance party with the Teletubbies! Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po dance and sing about silly things that make them smile.

programme.title: Pop Paper City (S1) - Doctor Mae-Mae
programme.desc: Plom's favourite toy is broken, so Doctor Mae-Mae promises to fix it. But when Doctor Mae-Mae realises she's taken on too many patients, she doesn't know if she'll be able to fix Plom's toy after all.

programme.title: Dog Loves Books (S1) - Dog Loves Calm
programme.desc: Dog and Pug escape a very noisy Bookshop to find Granny Pug who is leading a mediation retreat. They are trying to find a peaceful spot.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S1) - Comet
programme.desc: Messy has to save OKIDO from a falling comet before his bedtime! He sees that Mayor Oki still has his bath!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S1) - Bee Story
programme.desc: There's some funny 'buzzy-ness' going on in OKIDO. Where are all the bees? Messy and friends meet bee royalty and save the day!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - The Chickening
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo have to carry Jackson's big blue 'chicken' Ludwig (who definitely isn't a chicken) to the country fair. But the easily-startled bird gets away from them - the chase is on!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S1) - It's time for a sleepover
programme.desc: JoJo has a sleepover at Gran Gran's but is confused when bedtime comes while it's still light outside! Gran Gran creates their own starry sky for JoJo.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Beach Break
programme.desc: Sarah &amp; Duck are spending a day at the beach, aiming to build some sand animals.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Bubble Bumbling
programme.desc: The Bubble Man is in town so a visit to the Big Shop is in order for Sarah, Duck and Donkey.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S23) - The Other Big Engine
programme.desc: While working on the Brazilian Railway, Thomas Meets Gustavo, another big blue engine who reminds him of Gordon back home.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Wagon Ride
programme.desc: Bluey can't wait to get to the monkey bars as Dad takes her and Bingo on a wagon ride to the park. But her patience is tested when Dad keeps stopping to chat with other grown-ups.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Taxi
programme.desc: Bluey is running a taxi service. Her first passenger is Businessman Dad, who is in a rush to get to the airport. But with unexpected delays, Dad's in danger of missing his flight!

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - The Beach
programme.desc: As Mum goes for a walk along the beach, Bluey runs to catch up with her. Along the way, she has a series of encounters that both excite and test her in her first solo adventure.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Pea's Power Suit
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of Supertato, the world's first potato superhero as he tackles the mischievous Evil Pea, in the supermarket aisles.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Pet Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels meet a scruffelump in the woods, and despite Duggee's reservations, take him in. But they soon learn the responsibilities of taking care of a pet.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Lost Property Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels lose Tag in the Clubhouse but to find him they're going to have to figure out where the Lost Property room is.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Mountain Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels need to rescue Enid when they see her at the top of the Mighty Sugar Bun Mountain.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Bullet Train, Japan
programme.desc: All aboard for a high-speed adventure, as the Go Jetters visit Japan's Bullet Train.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Go Jet Academy: Wind Power
programme.desc: The team race to save Glitch when his kite flies too close to the academy's windfarm.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Gua Rusa, Borneo
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch discovers his Halloween pumpkin isn't as big as the Grimbots' one, he goes in search of some fertilizer to help it grow.

programme.title: My World Kitchen (S2) - Annabel's Austrian Kaiserschmarren
programme.desc: Annabel is making a dessert called Kaiserschmarren served with blueberries and raspberries. Annabel wears a traditional dress and invites her friends to her Austrian chalet.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures (S1) - African Penguins
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to Cape town, off the coast of South Africa, on a global adventure to find out why African penguins are living in the city.

programme.title: Swashbuckle (S7) - The Big Day
programme.desc: Seaweed is excited because today is THE BIG DAY, but he's forgotten what THE BIG DAY actually is. Can Captain Captain and Sandy help him remember?

programme.title: Panda and Krash (S1) - Football Fever
programme.desc: Krash finds a football somewhere and then he plays with it with He-He and Raccoon.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Charades
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want everyone to play charades, but Muffin and Socks are too young to understand the rules and Nana must think quickly to keep the game on track.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Sticky Gecko
programme.desc: Mum must get Bluey and Bingo out the door in time for a playdate, but they can't leave before they finish their game - waiting for a sticky rubber gecko to drop from the ceiling.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Seesaw
programme.desc: Dad has rudely plonked himself on one end of the seesaw. So Bluey and Bingo round up the entire playground to help move him off, but they still need to find one more friend.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Evil Pea's Party Plan
programme.desc: It's Evil Pea's birthday, but she and Carrot are trapped in the bottom of her freezer. They must put their differences aside and work together to escape.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels want to help Plinky find her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the 'Embroidery Bandit' starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: During the Three Kingdoms period, a Taoist priest Yu Ji cures many patients with his supernatural powers and is loved by the people. However, the arrogant general Sun Che thinks that Yu Ji bewitches people and orders for him to be beheaded. Subsequently, the spirit of the Yu Ji rises from his dead body and takes revenge on Sun Che.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by 'Dragon Gate Palace' one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together, they confront the head of 'Dragon Gate Palace', and uncover a long-hidden secret.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: This is a love story between an alluring fairy, Seventh Sister, who comes down from heaven to experience life in 70's Hong Kong, and a man who is running a debt laden orphanage. A heartless tycoon plans to take over the orphanage for its land but has to deal with Seventh Sister's magical powers as she aims to protect it from falling into his hands!

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuan's original hit.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three sworn brothers, Zhang, Huang and Ma ends when Ma gives in to corruption and falls for Huang's wife, eventually leading to a bloody ending.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tien's gang is helping them; he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tien's gang is helping them; he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the government's secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperor's ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao decides to defect but ends up being hunted by his friends, comrades and even his father.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: This tale of a honorable fighter's retraining in the "Iron Palm" style, that became the first international martial arts movie hit and made a continent-spanning star of Lo Lieh.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: Constable Wen Chao Fan and his father are framed for a jewel robbery they did not commit. On the run from the law and becoming a wanted fugitive, Wen must recover the jewels in order to clear his family name, but unfortunately he is not the only one seeking the stolen jewels...

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Tie Zhong Tang, the adopted son of the Great Banner Sect leader, is hunted by the sect's rival for the secret to its hidden treasure. To uncover the truth, he journeys to an island seeking the "Empress of the Day", only to find her dead. There, he unexpectedly meets the sect's founder, the "Emperor of the Night", who reveals that he is Tie's biological father.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: The story is about the legendary Monkey King (Liu Chung-chun) teams up with Goddess of Mercy (Chao Li-chuan) and the Dragon Girl (Lung Nu) to battle the child god Hung Hai-erh (Ting Hua-chung),son of the Ox Demon (Hung Hai-erh) to rescue Tang Tseng, the Holy Pilgrim (Teng Chio-jen).

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after it is attacked by the Qing army and is badly wounded. He is handed over to the Qing soldiers by Fang as he mistakes Hong for a bandit. When Fang realizes his mistakes, he tries all ways to help Hong escape so that they can team up to fight the Qing army together.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A dedicated chief constable nicknamed "The Invincible Fist" is chasing after a band of bandits near a village one day and encounters an innocent blind girl. He quickly falls in love with her, but finds out she is the daughter of a vicious bandit. Will he kill the father of his lover?

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Feng Yu Song Chun Gui - EP19
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Operation Bangkok
programme.desc: Military veteran Wu and undercover cop Ming rescue hostages on an island near Bangkok. Just as the mission is completed and they prepare to leave, Wu discovers his daughter has also been captured. Determined to save her, he stays with Ming to fight the thugs and rescue her.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called "Kung Fu Stuntmen". This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond...

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN’s English language service. programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Moonlight Run
programme.desc: Aja and Krel hitch a ride in Stuart’s old UFO on a mission to rescue Vex from a bounty hunter outpost on the Moon. Meanwhile, Zadra receives intel about Morando from a surprising new ally.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Dogfight Days of Summer
programme.desc: With Morando and his Armada heading for Earth, Aja and Krel clash with Vex and Zadra over how to handle the situation. Vex and Zadra want to alert human authorities, while the Royal teens seek out a more creative solution -- video games.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Ants Ants Revolution Clamsquatch
programme.desc: A group of fire ants swarm the city and it's up to Burn to race their leader in order to get them to leave. However, a worried Chet gets in the way. The crew travels to Mississippi for a race in the swamp. When Skidmark goes missing, they fear he has been taken by a creepy mythological creature.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Turbo Stinks Snails In Jail
programme.desc: On the day Turbo unveils a new cologne he has created, birds suddenly start attacking the city and it's up to the crew to figure out how to get rid of the feathery menaces before anyone gets eatenTravelling through the desert to visit a kid snail who is sick, the crew runs afoul of a villainous sheriff who puts them in jail until Turbo agrees to throw a race.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - A Taste of Crackridge The Bird and the Bee
programme.desc: Archibald's Souper Stew is a surprise hit with the residents of Crackridge. Archibald and his pal Bea reminisce about how they first met.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Stolen Key
programme.desc: It's the day of the Toyland Singalong and Clockwork Mouse, an enthusiastic but awful singer, says everything must be perfect! But then her precious key goes missing and Noddy need to quickly investigate: Who stole Clockwork Mouse's key?

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Missing Banner
programme.desc: The banner for Revs' Air show has disappeared. Where can it be ? Could someone be trying to spoil Revs' show? Noddy investigates.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Fallen Star
programme.desc: When the brightest star in the sky falls, Noddy has to find it and work out how to get it back into its place in the sky before its light goes out forever. Will he manage in time for the fairies Sparkle party ?

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Annoying Butterflies
programme.desc: A strange new kind of butterfly is pestering the toys in Toyland - just when the Queen organises a butterfly ball. Noddy has to find out what's going on fast !

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Elephant Has A Trunk
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Elephant had no nose. He couldn't swat away the flies, or scrub his belly… he couldn't even blow his nose. Then one day snappy Crocodile snapped! Crocodile pulled and he pulled and he pulled… until Ker-doing!!! Crocodile let go and Elephant's nose was all long and wiggly! And that's why Elephant has a trunk. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Snake Has No Legs
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Snake did have legs… hundreds and hundreds of them. But poor old Snake had no eyes, not a single eye on his head. Then on the day of the great Tinga Tinga Festival of Colours Snake quite literally bumped into Millipede who was stuck in a hole. They decided to swap eyes and legs just for one day. So that Snake could see all the wonderful colours and Millipede could run all over Tinga Tinga.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Spring Lamb
programme.desc: Julian's preparing for "spring has sprung", the Greendale school play, when pat gets a special delivery call. It's a yeti costume for Bill. When Pat is diverted into the countryside by PC Selby, he spots one of Alf's missing sheep - and she's about to have a lamb! Alf can't get there as his quad bike is being fixed, so Pat offers to take the sheep in his van. But the sheep is reluctant to move. Meanwhile, Bill is worried that his costume won't turn up and he'll let his classmates down.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Painted Sheep
programme.desc: Pat has got to deliver special cans of blue dye for Alf to mark up his cheeky runaway sheep. That way, when they get out, he can work out which sheep belong to him! Meanwhile, the kids are having a special delivery service day of their own as Ben gives them a tour of the Sorting Office.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Flash The Marshall
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor is going to ban Flash from Silver hatch unless he learns how to do something useful. Can Flash learn how to be a good marshal in time?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Hellie's A Winner
programme.desc: Hellie wants to be able to race like the cars. When he does join in he is accused of cheating. Hellie is upset and the cars annoyed… will they be able to make up before something disastrous happens?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Dodgems
programme.desc: Marsha decides to be a mechanic but wears Big Chris out with her endless questions. Disaster strikes when Chris dozes off and doesn't listen to her properly…

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Tall Story Roary
programme.desc: The loudspeaker system is not working at Silver Hatch. How will Roary be stopped from performing a dangerous stunt on the track?

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Knocked Down Fences
programme.desc: While Hoof is about to do his obstacle course, he finds all the fences knocked down. He blames Bling, who was jealous of the lucky wings he wears on his hoofs, but Bling assures she's got nothing to do with it ! Noddy investigates to settle their argument.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Unfinished Building
programme.desc: Strange accidents keep happening on the building site. Clockwork Mouse is convinced that someone is trying to stop them finishing the building. Noddy investigates and finds out things aren't quite as they seem...

programme.desc: Pat-Pat is doing a magic show but she discovers her magic box is broken. Noddy investigates: Who broke the magic box? He needs to find out soon so that Pat Pat's show can take place.

But when they fail to arrive at their first stop in Toy Green, Noddy investigates what's happened. He must set the Pirates back on course to complete the challenge by the end of the day.

Then, when the egg hatches, they meet Eggy, the Easter Kitty Bunny! For our Cat of the Day segment, Baby Box gets crafty.

When Tracy hires Cassie to babysit Nicholas, and Eden asks Athena and Phoebe to lend a helping hand, Cassie and the Dews must find a way to get Nicholas to bed without his missing and beloved penguin stuffy.

Along the way, CatRat plays silly tricks on them, but in the end Floyd manages to trick them all! For the Cat of the Day segment, all the Gabby Cats sing a special Cat-O-Ween song.

The unicorns are eager to play with a new mystery item that washes up on the beach, but what is it? While the other unicorns come up with imaginative ideas of what it could be, Pixie is determined to find out exactly what it is.

programme.desc: The PALs make plans for the Valentine's Day dance, then pivot to scare off a group of raiders who've come to rob the headmaster's vault.

programme.desc: Eep and Thunk become obsessed with a new trend known as "quicktogramming"Grug accidentally causes the first outbreak of a "super bug"

programme.desc: On an island that will make the perfect outpost, the Dragon Riders discover its indigenous residents are a mysterious new breed of dragon.

programme.desc: In order to earn the fire whip, Po and Blade have to get themselves and Rukhmini out of a lost city with no exits, but Rukhimi’s not exactly who she says she is. In the Cat-osphere, they take a twirl through Space Swirls and zip through the Supergallactic Doughnut Hole and even meet DJ Catnip's cousin, DJ Comet! For the Cat of the Day Segment, Baby Box and DJ Comet show us how to craft a papier-mâché Caturn.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Cupcake Tree
programme.desc: When the Gabby Cats get stuck in the leaves of an overgrown cupcake tree, it's up to Gabby, Pandy and cupcake-expert Cakey to work together to shrink the overgrown cupcake tree branch by branch--and to save CatRat from where he's stuck at the top! For our COTD segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - The Fairy Festival!
programme.desc: Kitty Fairy's garden is transformed into a fairy-riffic fairground for The Fairy Festival! At the festival, Gabby and Pandy meet an excitable little fairy named Luli-loo who joins them as they explore the festival. Luli-loo may not be the best at all the fair games, but she's never afraid to give it a go and learn from her mistakes!

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - The Boss Babysitter

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Spirit Day
programme.desc: Mega Fat CEO Baby holds a game day at Baby Corp and Boss Baby must find a way to beat Mega Fat CEO Baby at his own game

programme.desc: After being made fun of for sitting in chocolate pudding, George and Harold go into hiding only to come back to find that everybody has forgotten who they are

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Soggy Salvation of the Swirling Sweatnami
programme.desc: Tired of mean Mr. Krupp, the boys go back in time to prevent him from becoming a bully, but discover that their plan has backfired when they return to the present

programme.desc: In order to retrieve Mr. Krupp’s locked up rule book, George and Harold use an invention that ends up turning against them

Tony and his team are introduced to the other cool SH1FT3R racers, and while they can’t stop the heist without blowing their cover, they do manage to get a tracker on the train car Shashi and Layla stole.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Owl Job
programme.desc: Shashi sends Tony and Layla to steal weapons codes from a Russian oligarch, while Margaret "Echo" Pearl, Cisco and Frostee use Shashi’s absence to sneak into Shashi’s Cliffside mansion to investigate. programme.desc: Shashi stages a race up the privately-owned Mount Zebulon, and he invites Tony, Cisco, and Margaret "Echo" Pearl to participate. The crew soon discovers that Shashi is using the race to steal another super-car (this time from space!) - and he knows that Tony is working with the feds.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Not Lout
programme.desc: When Snotlout screws up a mission, he must learn to be a leader and earn the trust of the other riders.

programme.desc: When Mala and the Defenders of the Wing find a mysterious stranger who looks suspiciously like Dagur, Hiccup and Heather go to investigate.

programme.desc: Viggo gets angry at the dragon riders continually interfering with his business and uses a deep sea dragon, the Submaripper, to control Berk's trade.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Parental Guidance
programme.desc: The Trollhunters are paused from action when their parents stage an intervention to get answers from the kids.

He loses his title as Dragon Master and teams up with Wandering Blade, a knight on a mission from England, to track down the weasels and get his title back.

programme.desc: The arrival of Tronos - a bounty hunter with the power to control electricity - sparks an investigation by Area 49-B that threatens to expose the Royals’ alien identities. Meanwhile, Mother watches as the Royals struggle to work together to deal with this new threat.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Ill Gotten Gains
programme.desc: When Colonel Kubritz issues a medical quarantine that locks down the high school, Aja and Krel must avoid capture with help from their friends. Meanwhile Vex, Zadra, and Stuart have a run-in with a familiar face.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - There's Something About Gwen (of Gorbon)
programme.desc: When Stuart’s larger-than-life ex-girlfriend surprises him with a visit, Aja, Steve, Vex, and Nana join them on a triple date- where issues from each of their relationships come to a head. Meanwhile, Krel, Toby, and Eli discover a new passion: Sci-Fi filmmaking.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - A Tale Of Two Turbos The Escargot Affair
programme.desc: Turbo is surprised to learn that somebody in town is pretending to be him and must find the imposter before they can cause more trouble. Turbo is invited to a fancy dinner party in his honor but learns that he is actually on the menu, so it's up to the crew to save him.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Surf N Turf Hardcase Returns
programme.desc: The snails' relaxing day at the beach is threatened when the sewer surfing roaches challenge them to a surfing contest. Hardcase returns and threatens to take revenge on, so the crew becomes his bodyguards and takes the job a little too seriously.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Lake Ball Pit The Poppy Corn Festival
programme.desc: Cannonball! Archibald becomes a lifeguard at Lake Ball Pit. When Loy can't get along with a rival, Archibald gets a lesson in the art of sarcasm.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Stuck Toys
programme.desc: When Noddy arrives at Toy Green Station, he finds some toys stuck to the ground: someone has spread some glue all over the station platform! Why would someone do that? Noddy investigates.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Untidy Pirates
programme.desc: It's Tidy Toyland Day and Noddy wants to win the Tidy Toyland Trophy. Unfortunately he's also invited the untidy Pirates round to play! Noddy has to figure out how he can play with the Pirates and win the Tidy Toyland Trophy.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Ruined Race
programme.desc: It's the Brickabuild Sports &amp;amp; Fun Day and Clockwork Mouse tells Carlton she doesn't want ANY accidents. But when the Egg &amp;amp; Spoon Race comes to a grinding halt, Noddy has to find out who is trying to ruin the race.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Missing Investigation Kit
